hotspots.title: US Midterm Election Rout & MAGA Internal Backlash
hotspots.blurb: Following devastating losses in the 2026 midterm elections, Donald Trump elevated immigration hardliner Stephen Miller to White House Chief of Staff, inciting fierce pushback from House Republicans who labeled Miller a 'megalomaniac.' Simultaneously, Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth faces mounting calls for resignation while European far-right allies rapidly distance themselves from Trump's foreign policy.
hotspots.affect: The catastrophic election defeat has plunged the MAGA movement into acute internal civil war, with hardline White House appointments sparking open intra-party revolt and defensive rage.

hotspots.title: Polish Constitutional Court Crisis & Coup Accusations
hotspots.blurb: Right-wing opposition parties Law and Justice (PiS) and Confederation have staged protests in Opole and Warsaw against Prime Minister Donald Tusk's administration regarding control of the Constitutional Tribunal. PiS figures accuse the government of executing a 'coup d'état' and weaponizing law enforcement, while escalating tensions ahead of the upcoming 2026 Independence March.
hotspots.affect: High moral outrage and systemic panic frame the legal conflict over Poland's top court as an existential battle against state tyranny.

hotspots.title: Flávio Bolsonaro Defeat & Brazil Election Fraud Claims
hotspots.blurb: Following his election loss and defiance of a court travel ban, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro fled to the United States and resurfaced at Mar-a-Lago, declaring he intends to stay abroad and positioning himself for a 2030 presidential bid. While claiming in interviews that Brazil is no longer a functioning democracy, Flávio simultaneously conceded he lacks concrete proof of election fraud, as Brazil's Superior Electoral Court opens three new investigations against him.
hotspots.affect: Narratives of political persecution, defiance, and lingering election distrust collide with high-stakes legal jeopardy and right-wing factional maneuvering.

hotspots.title: Marine Le Pen Launches RN Campaign & Congress
hotspots.blurb: Rassemblement National leaders Marine Le Pen and Jordan Bardella have launched aggressive broadsides against La France Insoumise (LFI), framing the left's 2027 platform as a 'project for the dismantling of France.' RN figures are also mounting a fierce defense of conservative news channel CNews against left-wing calls for its closure, denouncing the effort as a 'totalitarian temptation.'
hotspots.affect: Culture-war battles over media freedom and apocalyptic rhetoric regarding France's national identity drive high affective investment ahead of the 2027 presidential cycle.

hotspots.title: Sweden Democrats Drop Cabinet Demand
hotspots.blurb: In a major political pivot, Sweden Democrats (SD) leader Jimmie Åkesson announced that the party is dropping its formal demand to join a right-wing cabinet, offering to support Ulf Kristersson's government from opposition as a powerful kingmaker. The move has triggered intense political maneuvering across Swedish parties, with opponents warning of a shadow-government setup while allies debate the revival of a center-right coalition.
hotspots.affect: Unexpected strategic gambits and intense parliamentary debate over right-wing power-sharing generate high political tension and tactical contention.
